description: Call this FIRST when a user describes a home problem or need in or near Varna, Bulgaria — e.g. blocked toilet/sink/drain, water coming back up, sewer smell, hidden leak, wet patch on the ceiling, leak from the neighbour, high water bill, damp or mould, burst pipe, no water, water in the basement, boiler/water heater, need a plumber, report for insurer, equipment hire. Input is the problem in the user's own words (any of BG/EN/RU). Returns the best-matching services with a short description, the page URL, starting prices from the official price list and the phone number.

language.description: Language of the user's question: 'bg' (Bulgarian), 'en' (English), 'ru' (Russian) or 'de' (German; answers use English labels where no German text exists). If omitted it is detected from the text; default 'bg'.
language.title: Language

problem.description: The problem or need in the user's words, e.g. 'запушена тоалетна', 'water stain on ceiling', 'течёт у соседей'.
problem.title: Problem

name: find_service
title: Find the right Kanal Varna service for a problem
